# Casebook terminology

The story's own words, for a writer who would otherwise miss or misuse them.

| Term             | Use it for                                                |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| A cold case      | A task that has slipped; colder with each slip            |
| The inspector    | The police, who step in only at the last escalation       |
| The drawing room | Where the cast gathers for the reveal; kept for a big win |
| Closed           | A finished task, filed away                               |
